name: Regenerative Land Initiative 2027
summary: A 2027 United States grant round for 501(c)(3) nonprofits running regenerative land management projects, including regenerative agriculture infrastructure, land education and ecosystem restoration. Elevar gives priority to organisations serving the greater Dayton, Ohio region.
reporting: Applicants need the ability to track measurable outcomes and carry out required reporting and analysis.

eligibility.rule: Be a 501(c)3 nonprofit organization or be fiscally sponsored by one
No lobbying, unrelated operating costs, reimbursement for completed work, or projects without measurable metrics

calls.label: 2027 Regenerative Land Initiative LOI

status.quote: Letter of Interest (LOI) must be received by January 31, 2027

deadline.quote: Letter of Interest (LOI) must be received by January 31, 2027

calls.note: Invited full proposals are due February 28, 2027.

administered_by.quote: Founded in 2025, the Elevar Fund is a philanthropic initiative based in Springboro, Ohio

applicant_types.quote: This grant program is designed to support 501(c)3 organizations with bold approaches toward improving land stewardship while generating measurable environmental, economic, and social benefits.

geography.quote: Geographically aligned - projects must be based in the United States

access.quote: This funding opportunity is a two-step process in which applicants will first submit a brief Letter of Intent (LOI) through the Elevar Fund's online grant interface describing the proposed project.
